Senior Backend Engineer - Platform Team

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Platform team. You will design and build scalable, high-performance backend services that power our core product. This role requires deep expertise in Python, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement scalable microservices using Python (FastAPI or Django)
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
- Architect and optimize PostgreSQL and Redis-based data storage solutions
- Develop event-driven systems using Apache Kafka or similar message brokers
- Lead technical design reviews and mentor junior engineers
- Monitor and improve system reliability, targeting 99.9% uptime SLA
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and data science
- Write comprehensive technical documentation

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python and modern Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django)
- Experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture
- Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and database optimization
- Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS preferred: ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3)
- Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS)
- Strong understanding of RESTful API design and best practices
- Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or CircleCI)
- Excellent communication skills and ability to mentor team members

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Kubernetes orchestration
- Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
- Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
- Contributions to open-source projects
- Experience with GraphQL

Benefits:
- Competitive salary: $180,000 - $230,000
- Remote-first culture
- Equity package
- Health, dental, vision insurance
- Unlimited PTO
